long_biography.plain_text:
Park ownership, site management, pitch fees and home sales became the operating system Alfie Best built around his park-home group. It expanded by acquiring established residential communities, improving sites and adding holiday parks across Britain. Best retained ownership and strategic control while stepping back from daily management.

Best is the controlling shareholder of the holding company above the group's park-management business. He resigned his group directorships in 2024 but remains publicly identified as its founder and chairman. Having relocated to Monaco, he continues to oversee private business interests while others lead daily operations.

uncertainties.detail: The authoritative owner export links Alfie Best to Wyldecrest, and a 2026 direct SuperYacht Times interview independently names the exact businessman as the vessel's owner. Companies House, Wyldecrest, current interviews and authenticated socials complete the person, company and legal-name chain. Vessel details are used only for identity resolution and excluded from biographies, wealth fields and tags.

Best resigned his Best Holdings and related group directorships in March 2024 but remains the active controlling shareholder and is still presented as Wyldecrest's founder-chairman. A current interview says he no longer runs the parks day to day and that his daughter leads the business; charity material identifies Waseem Hanif as chief executive. Because no dated current group organisation chart reconciles those operating mandates, the biographies state only that Best has stepped back from daily management.

The export's United Kingdom residence is stale. Companies House now gives Monaco for the verified controlling shareholder, and direct comments plus current exact-person profiles confirm relocation. The dossier proposes Monaco at 99 confidence while preserving British nationality.

Companies House gives the legal name Alfred William Best and April 1970, while the owner is consistently known publicly as Alfie Best. Lutterworth, Leicestershire, is supported by several direct profiles. No reliable reviewed source establishes an exact birth day, and low-quality pages conflict, so the day remains blank. Middle name William is not proposed because adding it alone would create the hybrid public/legal form 'Alfie William Best' without correcting the preferred first name.

Best worked with his father selling tarmac and describes both parents as entrepreneurial, but the family was financially poor and no substantial inherited asset, capital transfer or family company funded the principal park platform. His teenage trading, separately created phone chain, commercial property activity and park acquisitions support Self-made — independent start rather than an advantaged or inherited classification.

Recent direct and promotional sources use differing park counts and billion-pound valuations. Those figures are unnecessary to establish the business model or ownership and are volatile or self-reported, so they are excluded from biographies and classifications. No personal net worth or transaction proceeds are inferred.

The existing LinkedIn is authenticated by exact current Wyldecrest content and activity; an unrelated same-name Welsh council employee is excluded. Maison Danichgah directly links the existing Instagram handle, authenticating it. The stored alfiebest.co story URL now redirects into the Best Wealth Network business site and no longer functions as the original personal story page, so it is treated as stale for review rather than used as evidence or re-proposed. Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube, TikTok and Forbes searches found no additional personal profile meeting the authentication threshold.

Property developer would duplicate the same dimension without a clearer public occupational mandate, Commercial real estate is broader, and holiday parks are secondary to the residential platform, so Resort operations is not assigned.
